surfaces_and_shadows.cards: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300
surfaces_and_shadows.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 border-b border-stone-200 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces_and_shadows.buttons: rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300 active:scale-[0.98]

motion.page_load: fade-in, slide-up with 0.4s duration and stagger

components.navigation: Include Logo, Links (Home, Shop, Categories, About), Cart icon with badge. Sticky positioning. Glassmorphism.
components.hero: Full width or large rounded container (max-h-[80vh]). Image with overlay. Left-aligned text. H1 + Subtitle + Primary CTA.
components.product_grid: Bento-style or 3-4 column grid. Large images, subtle grey backgrounds for products, clean typography for price and title.
components.dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy, pure white surfaces on stone background. Compact spacing compared to storefront. Recharts for analytics.
components.checkout: Shadcn UI forms. Focused, zero-distraction layout. Order summary pinned to the right.

hero.alt: Curated lifestyle space with home goods, hardware, and candles

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the marketing/storefront pages to allow asymmetric grids and overlapping elements.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for the Admin Dashboard and complex interactive components (Shopping Cart sheet, Checkout forms).
Ensure the hero image has a subtle gradient overlay (bg-black/30) so text remains legible, but do not obscure the image entirely.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF for large blocks; use the provided off-white background (#FAF9F6) and deep charcoal text (#1C1917).
Implement the bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) for the categories section.
When rendering images, use 'object-cover' and ensure they do not exceed 80vh on mobile.
